title: FSSAI recalls coriander powder and carrageenan after reported contaminant findings
summary: The Indian Express reports recall orders following pesticide-residue findings in Shalimar’s Chef coriander powder and unsatisfactory cadmium results in carrageenan. This concerns the affected products, not a general ban on coriander or carrageenan. Report published 14 September; the original recall-order dates were not independently verified.

title: Canada: Co-op Gold frozen chicken products recalled for undeclared egg
summary: CFIA published a Class 2 notification for affected Co-op Gold Chicken Burgers and Maple & Brown Sugar Bacon Wrapped Chicken Bites. Retailers should not sell, serve or distribute the listed lots. The recall date is 10 September; this notice was first published on 14 September 2026. Check the source for exact lot codes and distribution.

The report links seven-day advance intimation and licensed-caterer checks for Ganpati community meals to Maharashtra FDA SOPs issued on 3 September. Treat this as reported local directions, not a new nationwide rule; the article says the precise penalty provision is unconfirmed.
title: Maharashtra festival-food advisory: societies asked to notify FDA before community meals

summary: Reuters reports that authorities declared the outbreak over on 11 September, while FDA continued investigating the contamination source. The report, updated 12 September, says implicated recalled iceberg lettuce is no longer on the market. Outbreak closure is not the same as completion of the investigation.
title: US authorities declare lettuce-linked cyclosporiasis outbreak over; investigation continues

summary: CFIA's warning covers 2 × 175 g packs distributed in Quebec, best before 10 October 2026. No associated illnesses were reported in the notice. Do not consume, sell or serve affected products; use the official notice to check identifiers.
title: Canada recalls Olymel Chicken Breast Strips over possible Listeria contamination

summary: The warning first published 10 September was corrected on 11 September. It covers PK Roasted Lemon N’ Chilli Peanuts, 65 g, batch CN94, best before 30 June 2027, in Ontario and Quebec, for possible Salmonella contamination. See the notice for the corrected identifiers and disposal instructions.
title: Canada corrects affected code in PK peanut Salmonella recall

summary: NSW Food Authority's 3 September report says L’Oven Bakery Supplies was convicted of 18 offences and fined A$84,000 on 28 August 2026. Charges arose from February 2024 hygiene, process-control and date-marking inspections. The authority says the prohibition order remains in place and the business remains closed.
title: NSW reports Sydney bakery conviction and continuing closure

summary: Reuters reports that an order issued on 10 September asks the government for a clear implementation pathway within 10 days. This is a court development, not a final notified labelling rule.
title: Supreme Court seeks a clear implementation pathway for food warning labels

summary: FDA's 9 September update reports 22 illnesses and two hospitalisations across four states. Evergreen Fresh Sprouts broccoli sprouts with specified September expiry dates are recalled. The investigation remains ongoing; see the official advisory for affected products.
title: FDA investigates Salmonella outbreak linked to recalled broccoli sprouts

summary: FSANZ, the joint Australia–New Zealand authority, reports a recall of 80g packs sold in Asian grocery stores in Victoria. All best-before dates through 25 February 2027 are affected. See the original notice for consumer instructions.
title: Red Hat Cookia matcha chocolate recalled for undeclared egg, milk and soy

summary: In its 6 July announcement, SQFI describes an Edition 9 code covering supplier approval, traceability, complaints and documentation for trade facilitators. Audits are annual and announced. GFSI benchmarking is expected in 2027, not described as already achieved.
title: SQFI launches an Agents & Brokers Code for non-handling trading businesses
Waitrose recalls Essential Pitted Black Olives because of Listeria
summary: The alert concerns specified use-by dates of the 120g product. Open the original recall for affected packs and consumer instructions.

title: JC Seafood recalls sweet chilli lime salmon portions over undeclared soy
summary: The recall concerns the 275g product. Read the original alert for affected batches, distribution and consumer instructions.

title: Food warning labels: stricter rollout considered during Supreme Court proceedings
summary: Reuters reports that FSSAI is considering a single-phase warning scheme covering products high in any one of the specified nutrients. The proposal remains under court scrutiny; this report is not a final notified regulation.

title: EFSA assesses the safety of aspartame-acesulfame salt (E 962)
summary: EFSA reports no safety concern at current exposure levels and recommends updates to specifications. This is a scientific assessment.

title: UK publishes sampling priorities for imported foods
summary: The national monitoring plan sets out sampling priorities for imported food.

title: Telangana suspends five food licences after Kukatpally inspection drive
summary: According to an ANI-based report, teams inspected 20 outlets on 9 September. Five licences were suspended and an unlicensed hostel was closed. Officials also collected food samples and issued improvement notices.

title: Siliguri municipality reports a routine food safety inspection
summary: A publicly indexed post from Siliguri Municipal Corporation describes an inspection at Roots and Goat Elevated Dining. The post can be opened on the corporation’s Facebook page; Facebook may require sign-in.

title: FSA publishes consultation outcome on three CBD novel-food applications
summary: Read the published consultation outcome and related application documents. A consultation outcome does not itself establish market authorisation.

title: Warning-label proposal draws objections from public health groups and industry
summary: Reuters reports competing objections to the proposed nutrient thresholds and exemptions. This story provides background to the continuing court proceedings.

title: Commission seeks evidence for implementing the new genomic techniques regulation
summary: The call for evidence concerns supporting delegated and implementing acts. It is a consultation stage, not the adoption of those acts.

title: FDA explains its classification of the Taylor Farms iceberg lettuce recall
summary: FDA explains that the Class I designation did not expand the original July recall or change which products were affected.

title: FSA explains Salmonella and eggs during an outbreak investigation
summary: The agency discusses egg safety in the context of its Salmonella Enteritidis investigation with UKHSA.

title: FDA finalizes guidance for ready-to-eat fresh-cut produce operations
summary: The final guidance addresses preventive controls and biological hazards in fresh-cut produce operations.

title: FDA and NOAA update certification procedures for seafood exports to the EU
summary: The agencies describe updated export certification procedures, including declarations concerning antimicrobial use.

title: Position of FSSAI on the use of identical flavours in Alcoholic Beverages

title: Position of FSSAI on the use of identical flavours in Alcoholic Beverages

summary: A manufacturing discussion examines how applying lean across production and supply chains can support operations closer to customers. Cross-industry insight, illustrated through GE Appliances.

title: LEI case study: building a learning system as an organisation grows
summary: The Theodo case study explores visual management, problem-solving and everyday learning. This software-industry example offers cross-industry continuous-improvement lessons.

title: BRCGS explains position statements effective from 10 August 2026
summary: The scheme owner links updated position statements and explanatory videos for food safety, packaging, agents and brokers, and storage and distribution. Publication date differs from the effective date.

title: BRCGS reports progress on Food Safety Issue 10 development
summary: BRCGS describes the technical working group shaping the next issue. This is a development update; the article does not announce Issue 10 as an effective certification requirement.

title: SQFI outlines Edition 10 changes and transition resources
summary: SQFI highlights food safety culture, change management, environmental monitoring and audit scoring. The announcement links official guidance, conversion training and implementation FAQs.

title: SGS explains conformity certification for Brazilian poultry exports to Saudi Arabia
summary: SGS describes shipment-level certificates of conformity for affected Brazilian poultry exports. The certification body’s September update states that the requirement took effect on 1 April 2026.

title: IFS updates doctrines for Food, Logistics, Broker and PACsecure
summary: IFS has revised normative doctrine documents covering technical clarifications, exceptional circumstances and food/product safety culture. The announcement links the updated documents for the four standards.

title: IFS Progress Logistics version 2: revised requirements and transition dates
summary: The updated development programme changes its checklist, scoring and assessment rules. Assessments may begin on 1 December 2026 and become mandatory on 1 March 2027. This is a programme supporting progress towards IFS Logistics certification.

title: AIB releases 2027 Consolidated Standards for inspections from January 2027
summary: AIB has released updated inspection standards for six food-supply-chain sectors, with change documents to support preparation. Inspections under the new edition begin on 1 January 2027.
